WITH status_counts AS (
  SELECT
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) AS project_count
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    archstat,
    project_count,
    project_count::numeric / SUM(project_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM status_counts
)
SELECT
  archstat,
  project_count,
  share,
  share - AVG(share) OVER () AS above_average_share
FROM shares
WHERE share > AVG(share) OVER ();

assumptions.assumption: A missing archstat is retained as its own SQL NULL group and returned as NULL.
